purpose: Deterministic reference rules and bounds, not an adopted building code or preapproved design

assumptions: One straight wall, continuous full-length studs, no openings
Includes a single stud at each end; does not include plates, corners, blocking, headers, cripples, waste or doubled studs

requirements: actual cross-section dimensions and load accounting
excluded: load combinations and live load reductions

explicit_opening_wall_takeoff.method: baseline centered stud grid minus studs strictly inside opening intervals plus explicitly specified additional full-length kings and short jacks
inputs: each rough opening start/width from left end inches
additional full-length king studs per side
assumptions: one straight wall segment, no edge-touching rough openings
opening intervals must be disjoint and non-touching
baseline grid stud exactly on an opening boundary stays counted; only additional kings are entered
shorter last bay ends with one stud

2x4.note: Typical dressed dimensions only; verify actual material and orientation

code_status: No jurisdiction-specific prescriptive span or fastening rules are bundled. Insert validated local rules only after identifying jurisdiction, adopted code edition and amendments.

output_policy.fail_closed: Missing safety-critical load and material values mean no pass/fail screening
